property_summary: Only the owner can successfully withdraw accumulated unclaimed fees; the reference contract always reverts for non-owner callers (so withdrawFees succeeds only when called by owner), whereas the mutant allows non-owners to withdraw causing owner-only invariant to break.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner restriction by deleting the onlyOwner modifier invocation so anyone can call withdrawFees (may cause withdrawFees to succeed where original reverted for non-owner callers).
